sources.title: Lumina-AI-Core/README.en.md at main · Happy-380/Lumina-AI-Core - GitHub
sources.snippet: An all‑in‑one AI assistant built on llama.cpp + local GGUF models (.NET 8 console application). Lumina‑AI runs completely offline, integrating local large‑model chat, Miya style transfer, role‑playing (Ewin / Miya), and Windows control via the MCP protocol. Lumina‑AI uses models from the Bonsai family, which are 1‑Bit LLMs.
